title: PYSEC-2025-19
summary: Affected: PyPI: picklescan picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

title: PYSEC-2024-115
summary: Affected: PyPI: langchain-community A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

title: CVE-2026-138026 — Crypto APIs MCP Servers (@cryptoapis-io/mcp-*) Missing Authentication via Streamable HTTP Transport
summary: Affected: Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-address-history, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-address-latest, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-aml, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-block-data, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-blockchain-events, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-blockchain-fees, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-broadcast, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-contracts, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-hd-wallet, Crypto APIs @cryptoapis-io/mcp-market-data and 4 more Crypto APIs MCP server packages (@cryptoapis-io/mcp-*) before 0.4.0, mcp-blockchain-events, mcp-blockchain-fees, mcp-broadcast and mcp-prepare-transactions before 0.5.0, and mcp-aml before 0.2.0 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to invoke tools using the operator's API key. When started with Streamable HTTP transport and --api-key, the server binds 0.0.0.0 and exposes /mcp, letting attackers consume paid credits, read account data, redirect event subscriptions, and delete HD wallet xPubs.

title: CVE-2026-138027 — Bagel before 2.5.5 Unsandboxed DuckDB SQL Execution via query_messages
summary: Affected: Extelligence-ai Bagel Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 exposes unsandboxed DuckDB SQL execution through the read-only annotated query_messages MCP tool, allowing file access and network requests. Attackers who prompt-inject the driving LLM via recorded logs or topics can invoke read_csv_auto, COPY TO, or httpfs to read and write files and perform server-side request forgery.

title: CVE-2026-138028 — Bagel before 2.5.5 Argument Injection via rsync Pipeline Task Options
summary: Affected: Extelligence-ai Bagel Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 contains an argument injection vulnerability in RsyncFilesToLocalDirectory that allows attackers to inject rsync options because only --quiet and --log-format values are rejected. Attackers who influence the LLM through prompt-injected content can trigger run_pipeline with -e/--rsh or --rsync-path options to execute commands as the Bagel server process.

title: CVE-2026-138029 — Wazuh-MCP-Server before commit 2bbfe12 SSRF via blueteam_check_webshell Hostname Bypass
summary: Affected: INFOKOM-KI Wazuh-MCP-Server Wazuh-MCP-Server before commit 2bbfe12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the blueteam_check_webshell tool because WebshellCheckInput.validate_url accepts DNS hostnames without resolving them. Attackers can supply URLs whose hostnames resolve or redirect to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, making curl reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints and leak response details.

title: CVE-2026-138030 — SylphxAI pdf-reader-mcp 2.4.1 through 3.1.4 SSRF via DNS Rebinding in URL Loader
summary: Affected: SylphxAI pdf-reader-mcp SylphxAI pdf-reader-mcp 2.4.1 through 3.0.14, 3.0.16, and 3.1.2 through 3.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in its PDF URL loader, which validates the resolved address but does not pin it for fetch(). Attackers controlling DNS for a url passed to read_pdf can return a public address at check time and an internal address at connection time to reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

title: CVE-2026-138031 — Typebot from 2.14.0 before 3.19.0 Cross-Workspace Webhook Disclosure via Unscoped webhookId
summary: Affected: baptisteArno typebot.io Typebot from 2.14.0 before 3.19.0 contains an authorization flaw that allows authenticated bot authors to reference another workspace's legacy webhook by saving a foreign webhookId in an HTTP request block. Attackers can have executeHttpRequestBlock return the victim's URL, headers and body client-side, or use handleSubscribeHttpRequest to overwrite the victim's webhook URL and redirect its data.

title: CVE-2026-138032 — WhoDB 0.88.0 before 0.132.0 MCP Read-Only Bypass via Server-Side File Writes
summary: Affected: clidey whodb WhoDB from 0.88.0 before 0.132.0 contains an access control bypass in the MCP whodb_query tool, letting callers run file-writing statements without approval because the sqlguard keyword classifier omits INTO, OUTFILE and DUMPFILE. MCP clients or prompt-injected models can execute PostgreSQL lo_export or MySQL SELECT INTO OUTFILE to create files on the database host and create tables, bypassing confirmation and read-only modes.

title: CVE-2026-138033 — mcp-video-analyzer 0.2.0 before 0.10.1 SSRF via Direct Video URLs
summary: Affected: guimatheus92 mcp-video-analyzer mcp-video-analyzer 0.2.0 before 0.10.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to reach internal addresses by supplying any http(s) URL ending in a video extension. Attackers can use prompt injection to make tools like get_frames fetch loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses directly or via redirects, writing responses to disk or returning rendered screenshots.
